Buscamos tornar o mercado de capitais mais dinâmico, acessível e conectado, criando oportunidades que impulsionam a mudança e fortalecem a economia.

No seu dia a dia você irá

  • Parametrizar e utilizar sistemas de geração de alertas de fraudes em operações com valores mobiliários;
  • Realizar análises e investigações de operações atípicas;
  • Elaborar relatórios para reguladores;
  • Enviar ofícios para participantes no âmbito de investigações de operações atípicas.

O que você precisa:

Serão considerados diferenciais:

  • Certificações profissionais como CPA-20, CEA, CNPI, CGA, ou certificações internacionais relacionadas a mercado de capitais.
  • MBA ou pós-graduação em Mercado Financeiro, Risco, Compliance, Regulação ou Direito do Mercado de Capitais;
  • Conhecimento de programação e data analytics aplicados à detecção de padrões e automação de alertas de supervisão.

title: Manager, Volunteer Engagement
description:
Manager, Volunteer Engagement

Department: Workforce, People & Culture

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Communications & Engagement Manager will play a central role in shaping, delivering, and elevating the end-to-end communications and engagement strategy for the FIFA Volunteer Programme across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to oversee the development, coordination, and execution of all volunteer-related communications and engagement initiatives. This includes creating and implementing the overall communications plan, leading launch and promotional campaigns, managing key milestones, and delivering a structured and aligned content plan across both internal and external channels to ensure consistent and impactful communication. The successful candidate will also drive the engagement strategy covering activations such as the trophy tour, ambassador participation, mascot appearances, and partner-related activities to further build motivation, visibility, and community among volunteers.

This role will collaborate closely with the Volunteer Management team in FIFA Zurich, eight Host Cities in Brazil, the Brand and Marketing teams, external agencies, and other Functional Areas to ensure consistent, high‑quality messaging and impactful engagement touchpoints throughout the volunteer journey. This will include all touch points from launch to internal communication to volunteers.

We are seeking an experienced communications professional with a proven track record in managing complex, large‑scale communications campaigns for events and in designing informative, motivating, and culturally relevant engagement initiatives to lead the Volunteer Programme communications for diverse volunteer audiences (local and international) from the application phase through tournament‑time. The ideal candidate understands mindset of volunteer, can translate local context into global communications frameworks, has experience in large‑scale event delivery and thrives in a dynamic, multicultural environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the development and implementation of the FWWC27 Volunteer Communications & Engagement Strategy including the initial launch of the volunteer programme,
  • Ensure alignment with FIFA Women's World Cup strategy, FIFA’s global volunteer communications and engagement strategy, brand guidelines, and tournament timelines
  • Act as the primary liaison with FIFA Zurich, FIFA 27, Host Cities, and external agencies on topics related to communications and engagement.
  • Deliver key communication and engagement milestones from planning, recruitment through to tournament‑time and post‑event legacy.
  • Co‑lead communications related to the volunteer launch campaign, including messaging, creative briefs, KPIs, and rollout.
  • Draft and prepare engaging written, visual and digital content (in English and Portuguese) throughout the full journey for the volunteer platform, website, social media, FAQs, newsletters, volunteer support channel and operational communications.Right to work in Brazil.
  • Identify opportunities to highlight the Volunteer Programme via Media and Public Relations support.
  • Coordinate and integrate Host Country communications and messaging into a unified, coherent strategy that reflects the tournament's values, brand, and legacy objectives.
  • Provide Host Cities with communication toolkits, guidelines, and templates.
  • Ensure messaging consistency, accuracy, cultural relevance and crisis communication when required.
  • Ensure all internal and external messaging supports programme goals, celebrates volunteer contributions, and strengthens volunteer satisfaction and retention.
  • Oversee end‑to‑end planning and delivery of assigned communications projects, ensuring alignment between internal teams, host cities, external agencies, and other key partners.
  • Manage external stakeholders and agencies, defining requirements, providing clear briefs, aligning expectations, and ensuring an efficient end‑to‑end RFP process.
  • Lead development and execution of volunteer engagement initiatives including but not limited to trophy tour activations, ambassador and mascot appearances, partner‑related activities and tournament time engagement activities in volunteer centres.
  • Prepare and deliver communication and engagement how‑to materials, for FIFA27 and Host City team members to understand how to deliver communication and engagement deliverables.
  • Act as the liaison with Marketing, Brand & Communications teams to ensure consistency in brand, messaging, and tone, while providing cross‑functional support to other divisions including Digital, Media Relations, Content Production, and Event Communications.
  • Track and report performance of communications campaigns, content reach, engagement levels, and activation impact.
  • Provide regular updates to the Senior Volunteer Manager and FIFA27 top management and work closely with the FIFA Zurich team to ensure alignment with the global FIFA Volunteer Programme strategy.
  • Capture lessons learned and feed them into continuous improvement for future events.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 5+ years of communications experience, preferably within major events or large‑scale volunteer programmes.
  • University degree in Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, Business or related field.
  • Masters in Sports Management or Event Management is an asset.
  • Proven experience in delivering FIFA tournaments, major sports events or other international events is advantageous.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to craft clear, engaging messages.
  • Creative thinking with a keen sense for storytelling and brand innovation.
  • Proven expertise in content creation, social media strategy, and media relations.
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems and related IT tools is a plus.
  • Strong project management skills with experience delivering campaigns or large‑scale communication plans.
  • Comfortable working with creative tools and platforms (e.g., Adobe Suite, CMS/web design platforms, Photoshop, Final Cut Pro, Audacity. Additional qualification in web design or animation is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate across departments and manage relationships with diverse stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success in delivering audience engagement strategies and activation events.
  • Experience working in multicultural environments; knowledge of Brazil/South America sport and cultural ecosystem is an advantage.
  • Positive, collaborative, solutions‑driven mindset; able to work autonomously and under tight timelines.
  • Team‑oriented and passion for volunteerism, community engagement, diversity, inclusion, and gender empowerment.
  • Experience working with culturally diverse teams across multiple locations/time zones.
  • Understanding of volunteer motivation and behaviour across different cultural contexts.
  • Budget Management and oversee service provider deliverables
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

A São Carlos Saúde Oncológica é um hospital que construiu, ao longo das últimas cinco décadas, uma trajetória em saúde oncológica no Rio de Janeiro, com o objetivo de oferecer um tratamento oncológico próximo e personalizado.Desde a sua fundação, em 1967, passando por cada geração, até os dias atuais, todos procuram a São Carlos Saúde Oncológica com um único objetivo: o câncer. Nós já nascemos para cuidar do paciente oncológico.

Para isso, acreditamos no trabalho em equipe e investimos na composição de uma estrutura interdisciplinar em que o paciente e seus familiares encontram tudo o que precisam em um só lugar, 24h por dia. Para nós, a vida vale muito. E por esse motivo, buscamos ressignificar o câncer e seu efeito nas vidas pessoas. Aqui, vamos além da doença e do tratamento em si. Encaramos o câncer de frente, como uma causa que precisa ser abordada sem tabu, sem medo e com muita coragem.

description:
Senior Operational Auditor- Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat family relocation package.

Overview

We are seeking an operational auditor with substantial auditing or operational experience in Upstream or Downstream to join Internal Auditing Organization. The Internal Auditing is responsible for helping organizations to accomplish their objectives by bringing a systematic and disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of the organization’s risk management, control, and governance processes.

Your primary role will be to lead and oversee the audit team while serving as the primary liaison for clients, ensuring strong relationships and high-quality delivery throughout the engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Establish the objective and scope of the audit engagement.
  • Identify key risks and controls within the business and operational processes under review.
  • Develop comprehensive risk-based audit programs.
  • Responsible for the audit team and will be overseeing assistant auditors.
  • Discuss concerns and issues with the audit client, draft field memorandums, and update client and Internal Auditing Management on progress of the audit.
  • Execute risk-based audit procedures in alignment with company policies and international standards.
  • Deliver presentations to client management at the audit opening and closing meetings.
  • Provide on-the-job training and mentoring to less experienced staff.
  • Evaluate the performance and capabilities of the assisting staff auditors.
  • Provide assurance and consulting activities on internal controls as requested.
  • As a successful candidate, you will hold a bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, engineering, or another related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
  • You will have a minimum of 7 years of experience in auditing, engineering, or plant operations within the oil and gas industry or from one of the Big Four Auditing firms (Deloitte, PwC, EY and KPMG).
  • You should hold at least one professional certification, such as the Certified Internal Auditor, Certified Public Accountant, Chartered Accountant, or a similar professional credential.
  • You must demonstrate excellent oral and written communication skills in the English language and excellent presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • You should be flexible to travel within the Kingdom and/or outside the Kingdom to conduct audit and consulting engagements.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

O que faz um vendedor PaP?

O que faz um supervisor Pap?

Seu papel é liderar a equipe na busca dos melhores resultados, garantindo que a equipe siga os direcionamentos avaliando as entregas e oportunidades propostas em cima dos desafios regionais e plano comercial!

Temos oportunidades em todos os estados do Brasil.

Quais os requisitos mínimos para concorrer à vaga?

Para vendedor: Ter no mínimo 18 anos, ensino fundamental completo e experiência com vendas (de qualquer modalidade).

Para supervisor: Ter no mínimo 18 anos, ensino médio completo, experiência com vendas e liderança, CNH e veículo próprio.

Como é o processo seletivo?

Você fará seu cadastro, participará de uma entrevista com o RH e depois com o requisitante.

Processo simples e rápido! #VemserAtento!

Quais os benefícios?

Acesse a vaga da sua região e verifique as informações de salário, comissão e benefícios!#TransparêncianoProcesso!

Conheça também os nossos outros Portais de Carreiras:

Interfile – com vagas voltadas para soluções de backoffice e gestão de processos;

Esclarecemos que nenhum valor é cobrado para que você participe dos nossos processos seletivos. title: Senior Coating Advisor
description:
Job Title: Senior Coating Advisor
Location: Applicants must reside in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
Schedule: Remote
Department: Technical Services
Reports To: Area Manager Service Operations, Argentina & Brazil
Travel Requirement: Up to 80% travel, both domestic and international, with a valid US visa.
Important: Please submit CVs in English

About Hempel: Founded in Denmark in 1915, Hempel is a world‑leading supplier of trusted coating solutions. Across the globe, our products protect and beautify buildings, infrastructure and other assets, and play an essential role in our customers' businesses. They help minimize maintenance costs, improve aesthetics, and increase energy efficiency. Through our brands Hempel, Neogard, Crown Paints, Wattyl and Farrow & Ball, we provide solutions for the Marine, Energy, Infrastructure and Decorative industries.

Job Summary: Hempel is seeking an experienced and technically skilled Senior Coating Advisor to join our Technical Services team in Brazil, within the marine segment. The role is responsible for providing technical advice and support to sales teams, as well as conducting technical analyses of product configurations to determine customer‑specific pricing. Key responsibilities include preparing and conducting technical sales briefings for customers and company representatives, researching customer technical specifications, estimating the costs, resources, time, and technical requirements for modifying, configuring, and installing products or solutions, and evaluating sales proposals to ensure they are technically accurate and aligned with the organization’s quality standards.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Fulfill assigned projects in accordance with the requirements of the Work Orders.
  • Advise customers on correct use of Hempel products and paint systems by following instructions provided in current technical documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with agreed painting specifications, including technical standards, work procedures and best painting practices.
  • Keep all parties informed of work progress through Progress Reports. In case of deviations or non‑conformities, notify the customer in writing, provide recommendations for preventive/corrective actions, and follow up on their implementation.
  • Monitor and control paint inventory for the project, provide timely updates to front/back office sales, and ensure proper implementation of paint consumption planning and procedures.
  • Conduct coating condition surveys onshore and offshore as required.
  • Actively participate in claim handling procedures and assist in their resolution.
  • Provide pre‑sales and/or post‑sales technical support to customers, including testing and maintaining products, equipment and services; evaluate and recommend new products or equipment upgrades as needed to meet customer requirements.
  • Monitor and resolve recurring issues to ensure ongoing customer satisfaction.
  • Manage complex and large‑scale projects effectively.
  • Train customers on the features and application of purchased products when needed.
  • Ensure quality and timely reporting of all work activities.
  • Support the sales force regarding technical aspects of the company’s products and services.
  • Complete all required reports with high quality and on time.
  • Utilize information tools efficiently in accordance with Hempel’s procedures.
  • Ensure all Technical Services staff equipment is used according to project procedures and specifications, and that all equipment is calibrated and in good working condition.
  • Comply with training programs to acquire the necessary skills, knowledge and behaviours.
  • Travel to project sites and prepare/distribute technical reports; travel accounts for approximately 80% of working time, both domestically and internationally.
  • Conduct work safely and responsibly, following Hempel’s HSE guidelines and the HSE procedures of each worksite.
  • Use all required personal protective equipment (PPE) and ensure it is always in good condition for the job.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English is required; Spanish is a plus.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a Coating Advisor in a technical service role, preferably within the marine segment.
  • Relevant certifications such as NACE, FROSIO, ABRACO or IARCOR.
  • Strong knowledge of the paint and coatings industry.
  • Technologically proficient and comfortable using digital reporting tools.
  • University degree in Chemistry or a related field is a plus.
  • Completion of required internal training as outlined in Hempel’s Group Training Policy.

Benefits

  • 100% employer‑paid medical coverage for you and your immediate family (spouse and children).
  • Paid vacations.
  • 13th salary.
  • Severance fund (FGTS).
  • Social security.
  • Paid sick leave.
  • Company car.

Application due:
Seniority Level: Associate
Job Functions: Customer Service, Project Management, Quality Assurance
Industry: Chemicals

At Hempel we are committed to everyone feeling safe, valued and treated equally, in an environment where each employee can bring their authentic selves to work. We believe that inclusion is key to innovation and by bringing together the most diverse perspectives and talents, we can achieve great things together.

Buscamos um profissional que será responsável por garantir a saúde, segurança e integridade dos colaboradores, identificando, avaliando e controlando riscos ocupacionais, elaborando programas e documentos técnicos de SST, promovendo treinamentos e orientações, e assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e normas regulamentadoras.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar visitas técnicas para reconhecimento de riscos ocupacionais por meio de inspeções presenciais nos locais de trabalho das empresas clientes, observando processos, atividades e condições ambientais, a fim de identificar potenciais riscos, subsidiar a elaboração de programas, laudos e relatórios de segurança e indicar medidas preventivas necessárias.
  • Realizar avaliações ambientais quantitativas nos locais de trabalho das empresas clientes utilizando equipamentos calibrados, como dosímetros, bombas gravimétricas e decibelímetros, a fim de obter dados técnicos precisos sobre a exposição a agentes físicos, químicos e biológicos, subsidiando a elaboração de programas, laudos e relatórios exigidos por legislação e normas regulamentadoras.
  • Realizar análise de riscos ocupacionais nas empresas clientes avaliando informações coletadas em campo e comparando-as com a legislação e normas aplicáveis, a fim de classificar riscos, subsidiar a elaboração de documentos técnicos e orientar sobre medidas de controle que reduzam a exposição dos trabalhadores.
  • Receber e validar checklists das visitas técnicas realizadas por profissionais de campo, conferindo o correto preenchimento conforme padrões estabelecidos, a fim de garantir a confiabilidade dos registros para acompanhamento de conformidades e subsidiar a elaboração de programas, laudos e relatórios da área.

  • Inspecionar ambientes de trabalho observando atividades, condições físicas, máquinas e equipamentos, registrando não conformidades, a fim de propor ações corretivas e preventivas que promovam ambientes mais seguros e conformes.
  • Prestar orientações técnicas de SST aos clientes respondendo demandas por e‑mail, reuniões ou visitas, fundamentadas em legislação e boas práticas, a fim de apoiar gestores e trabalhadores na tomada de decisão em relação à saúde e segurança.
  • Realizar reuniões técnicas com clientes participando de encontros presenciais ou virtuais para alinhamento de ações e esclarecimento de dúvidas, a fim de manter comunicação clara e transparente e garantir o alinhamento entre consultoria e cliente.

  • Realizar análises técnicas presenciais por meio de inspeções e observações em campo, a fim de subsidiar a elaboração de programas, laudos e relatórios da área.
  • Realizar outras atividades profissionais correlatas e inerentes ao cargo exercido, conforme necessidade e/ou demanda da área, sempre que necessário, por meio de treinamento, qualificação profissional e orientações do líder imediato, a fim de garantir o desenvolvimento profissional contínuo.

description:
Snapshot of Your Day

In this role, you will drive our digitalization initiatives forward, ensuring seamless integration with automation systems. Your mission is to transform operational data into actionable insights, securely bridging Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT) environments. While your primary strength lies in digitalization, a practical understanding of automation, or a strong willingness to learn, will enable you to design robust architectures that support advanced analytics, asset visibility, and performance optimization.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Act as the technical bridge between digitalization teams, IT/cloud specialists, and automation engineers.
  • Design and implement secure data pipelines from sensors and control systems to digital platforms.
  • Configure and maintain industrial applications in hybrid environments (on‑premise and cloud).
  • Enable scalable solutions for condition monitoring, predictive analytics, and performance optimization.
  • Ensure compliance with cybersecurity and industrial communication standards.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to translate operational needs into digital solutions.

Qualifications

  • Solid experience in digitalization, IoT, and data integration.
  • Practical knowledge of automation systems (PCS 7, SIMATIC, or similar) or strong motivation to learn.
  • Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (OPC UA, MQTT, PROFINET).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) and virtualized environments.
  • Understanding of industrial networking, cybersecurity, and OT/IT integration.
  • Hands‑on exposure to edge computing, gateways, and IoT platforms.
  • Programming skills in Python for automation and data processing tasks.
  • Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Fluent English; additional languages are a plus.

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Growing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. Our focus is on decarbonizing manufacturing and adopting balanced approaches with industry clients, global networks, tech, and coordinated implementation.

About Siemens Energy

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than ~100,000 dedicated employees, we generate electricity for over 16% of the global community and use our technology to help protect people and the environment. Our cross‑border team is committed to redefining the energy sector by exploring new possibilities to achieve balanced, reliable, and affordable energy solutions.

Office Location

Siemens Energy's location in One Cotroceni Park is not just an office space – it’s a hub for a vibrant and growing community! Nestled in the heart of Bucharest, this urban development offers green spaces, shopping destinations, and everything the city center has to offer, with the Academia Militara subway station just a 3‑minute walk away.

Diversity & Inclusion

We celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. Diversity is our strength and fuels our collective creative energy.

Benefits

  • Flexible work schedules guarantee a good work‑life balance.
  • Access ongoing professional and personal development through training programs.
  • SE meal tickets for lunch.
  • Bookster program for book lovers.

Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

The Automation Engineer is responsible for working with our customers to design solutions to control, monitor and automate their industrial processes. On this level it is expected to demonstrate the ability to manage customer expectations and product quality from tendering through life of the field. This includes design and configuration of control systems of varying complexity and coaching peers in good design and better practices. The candidate must demonstrate process and project management skills to function effectively with customers, peers and the product development team.

Job Description

  • Architect, design, implement, unit test and deliver high quality, performant software applications.
  • Work cross functionally with software, application, and quality engineers to ensure products meet engineering and client success criteria.
  • Actively participate in the definition and implementation of new processes and improvements.
  • Identify and create new technologies and ideas to increase the organization’s intellectual property and to better address customer needs.
  • Present your designs and solutions to internal and external teams and review designs of software and quality engineers.
  • Coordinate with QA team to develop test plans and test automation processes to increase automated functional tests.
  • Mentor team in development technologies, tools, and processes.

You are meant for this job if:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher within Electronic, Controls & Automation, Mechatronics, Chemical, Electrical, Computer Science or equivalent Engineering, with focus on industrial process control.
  • Active CREA
  • Advanced English
  • Experience in developing automated applications or research that involved process automation
  • Experience within configuration and design of industrial control systems on the hardware, software or modelling side.
  • Design, review and implement both the software and hardware components of a control system from instrumentation to the operator HMI.
  • Understand dynamics within linear and non-linear systems in general, but upstream oil and gas processes in special.
  • Release project documentation, according to International Standards and Customer requirements and present them for customer approval.
  • Understand pros and cons of industrial protocols, such as Modbus, Profibus, serial, etc. and how they are used.
  • Advanced experience with multiple text and visual programming languages
  • Experience with Python programming is highly desirable

description:
Operator de Cedoc (Exclusiva PcD)

Iron Mountain is seeking an Operator de Cedoc to join our team. This role focuses on managing and organizing the storage of documents and records in a safe and efficient manner.

Responsibilities

  • Respetar as normas e procedimentos de segurança e uso de EPI’s (Equipamento de Proteção Individual) fornecidos pela empresa e higiene do trabalho estabelecidas para a sua área de atuação;
  • Implantar e incluir volumes (caixas) no sistema interno SKP (SafeKeeper), receber e conferir a demanda, efetuar a troca da cartonagem quando necessário e liberar volume para a guarda, mantendo assim a organização e garantia dos processos;
  • Movimentar caixas manualmente ou com auxílio de equipamentos manuais ou de força motriz própria, dentro das dependências da Unidade;
  • Localizar, quais os locais (endereços) em que as caixas serão guardadas conforme sistema interno SKP, e levá-las a este local, utilizando-se de diversos recursos, como: leitor de código de barras, carrinhos, escadas, prateleiras equipadas com rodízios, etc;
  • Procurar e localizar caixas de documentos, seguindo instruções ou indicações de endereços (corredores, prateleiras, níveis, etc) estabelecidos pelos procedimentos vigentes ou instruções dadas pelo superior. Após os trabalhos de pesquisa, retornar estes volumes ao local inicial;
  • Preencher relatórios de suas atividades diárias (formulário OPLOG), conforme os modelos e procedimentos IMB, para avaliação e controle da produção individual e do departamento;
  • Zelar para que todos os volumes e equipamentos usados sejam preservados nas condições de conservação;
  • Relatar qualquer alteração ou irregularidade nos equipamentos de movimentação de carga, auxiliando no preenchimento da lista de verificação (check-list);
  • Quando não há trabalhos de sua função direta poderá auxiliar os demais departamentos.

description:
Job type

Full-time employee Full-time employee

Overview

Buscamos técnico de laboratório, com vivência hospitalar anterior, para integrar o nosso time que transforma a vida em protagonista.

A São Carlos Saúde Oncológica é um hospital que construiu, ao longo das últimas cinco décadas, uma trajetória em saúde oncológica no Rio de Janeiro, com o objetivo de oferecer um tratamento oncológico próximo e personalizado. Desde a sua fundação, em 1967, passando por cada geração, até os dias atuais, todos procuram a São Carlos Saúde Oncológica com um único objetivo: o câncer. Nós já nascemos para cuidar do paciente oncológico.

Para isso, acreditamos no trabalho em equipe e investimos na composição de uma estrutura interdisciplinar em que o paciente e seus familiares encontram tudo o que precisam em um só lugar, 24h por dia. É o nosso conceito One Stop Care, que reúne Internação, Pronto Atendimento 24h, Quimioterapia, Radioterapia, bem como toda a parte de Medicina Nuclear (diagnóstica e terapêutica), Exames e Consultas com especialistas das mais diferentes áreas - todos voltados para a Oncologia.

Para nós, a vida vale muito. E por esse motivo, buscamos ressignificar o câncer e seu efeito nas vidas pessoas. Aqui, vamos além da doença e do tratamento em si. Encaramos o câncer de frente, como uma causa que precisa ser abordada sem tabu, sem medo e com muita coragem.

Responsibilities

  • Manipular soluções químicas, reagentes e outros;
  • Analisar e interpretar informações obtidas de medições, determinações, identificações, definindo procedimentos técnicos a serem adotados, sob supervisão;
  • Interpretar resultados dos exames, ensaios e testes, sob orientação, encaminhando-os para a elaboração de laudos, quando necessário;
  • Proceder a realização de exames laboratoriais sob supervisão;
  • Separar soros, plasmas e outros;
  • Preparar os equipamentos e aparelhos do laboratório para utilização;
  • Coletar e ou preparar material, matéria prima e amostras;
  • Zelar pela manutenção, limpeza, assepsia e conservação de equipamentos e utensílios do laboratório em conformidade com as normas de qualidade, de biossegurança e controle do meio-ambiente;
  • Participar de programa de treinamento, quando convocado;
  • Executar tarefas pertinentes à área de atuação, utilizando-se de equipamentos e programas de informática;
  • Executar outras tarefas compatíveis com as exigências para o exercício da função;

Qualifications

  • Formação técnica / superior - (Laboratório, patologia, biologia, análises clínicas e áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência anterior na função e vivência hospitalar;
  • Conhecimento em sistema MV;

Benefits

  • Alimentação no local;
  • Convênio com instituições de ensino;
  • Auxílio creche para mulheres;

description:
Balconista de Medicamentos

Rede D'Or Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Local de trabalho: Cascadura (Hospital Norte D'Or), Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Escala de trabalho: 180 - (12X36) - 19:00 01:00 02:00 07:00 - NOT B

Disponibilidade para treinamento.

  • Experiência: Desejável com controle e armazenamento de remédios;
  • Desejável conhecimento dos processos administrativos;
  • Necessário Excel Básico;
  • Realizar atividades inerentes a conferência, estocagem, dispensação, controle e distribuição de medicamentos e matérias descartáveis manipulados pela Farmácia, recebidos do Almoxarifado e Farmácia Macro, com a finalidade de atender às necessidades da rede, de acordo com as normas da Unidade. Entregar os medicamentos dispensados pela farmácia, transportando de forma segura dentro dos prazos contratualizados entre as áreas, a fim de garantir o atendimento das solicitações realizadas pelas áreas, de acordo com os conhecimentos técnicos e científicos e as normas da Instituição, sob a luz do Código de Ética;
  • Conferir os medicamentos e materiais AE23 recebidos do almoxarifado e da Farmácia Macro, garantindo que as quantidades, concentração e apresentação dos medicamentos estejam de acordo com o especificado em relatório específico, a fim de providenciar o devido armazenamento dos itens em estoque físico. Organizar os medicamentos e materiais descartáveis recebidos em seus devidos locais de armazenamento, respeitando as características de limites de empilhamento e arrumação definidas pelo superior imediato. Fracionar/unitarizar medicamentos sólidos para dispensação das doses prescritas aos pacientes, bem como para Farmácia Macro, visando atender/ repor os estoques dos Arsenais. Efetuar as dispensações de medicamentos, separando e acondicionando adequadamente cada item, de acordo com o especificado nas requisições emitidas do sistema informatizado, a fim de atender as solicitações dos requisitantes dentro dos prazos contratualizados com as áreas. Conferir todos os fracionamentos realizados para identificar e corrigir possíveis erros de dispensação, conforme procedimentos de checagem das doses produzidas, definido pelo superior imediato;
  • Transportar e entregar os medicamentos em geral e quimioterápicos, nutrição parenteral e soluções de diálise dispensados pela farmácia, para os setores assistenciais da Unidade, bem como obter e conferir assinatura dos destinatários atestando o recebimento dos itens especificados nas requisições. Recolher os medicamentos dispensados e não utilizados pelos pacientes a cada período de 2(duas) horas, verificando se o formulário de devolução está devidamente preenchido e assinado. Arquivar os controles de recebimento de medicamentos retornados em pastas/escaners específicos e de acordo com os setores. Buscar medicamentos não esterilizados e controlados por órgão público competente (Fundação Oswaldo Cruz, Secretaria Estadual de Saúde, FUNASA, entre outros), para atender pacientes hospitalizados, entregando nos Setores de destino de cada órgão nos respectivos receituários médicos.
  • Outras informações:

    • Escala de trabalho: 180 - (12X36) - 19:00 01:00 02:00 07:00 - NOT B;
    • Disponibilidade para treinamento.

description: Financial Controller – Brazil Location: Rio de Janeiro Employment Type: Permanent | Full-time Role Overview A global financial services organisation is seeking a qualified Financial Controller to take full ownership of statutory, management, and operational finance for its Brazil entity. This is a standalone senior finance role with end-to-end accountability for financial control, regulatory compliance, reporting accuracy, systems optimisation, and cross-border financial governance. The position operates as the primary financial authority for Brazil, acting as the key interface with global finance leadership, external auditors, tax authorities, and regional stakeholders. The role requires deep technical accounting expertise within a regulated, multi-currency, international environment, alongside hands-on ownership of financial systems, controls, and transformation initiatives. Key Responsibilities Full ownership of end-to-end finance operations for the Brazil entity, covering general ledger, AP, AR, fixed assets, cash and balance sheet integrity. Production of accurate and timely monthly management accounts, including detailed variance analysis, KPI reporting and financial performance commentary. End-to-end responsibility for statutory reporting, including preparation and submission of annual financial statements and all federal and state tax filings. Ownership of the month-end and year-end close process, including journals, reconciliations, balance sheet substantiation and audit readiness. Development, implementation and ongoing monitoring of internal controls to ensure compliance with group policies, local regulation and audit standards. Lead the full external audit process, acting as primary point of contact for auditors and resolving technical accounting and control issues. Oversight of transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance in partnership with central tax teams. Drive finance process improvement, automation and system optimisation across record-to-report, procure-to-pay and order-to-cash cycles. Lead initiatives to reduce close timelines, improve working capital efficiency and enhance cash flow forecasting accuracy. Act as finance lead for strategic projects including business growth, restructuring, system upgrades, new entity launches and M&A activity. Key Requirements (Technical Only) Fully qualified accountant: CRC, CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA or international equivalent. Proven experience in financial control, controllership or senior finance leadership within a regulated, multi-entity environment. Strong technical knowledge of US GAAP and international accounting standards (IFRS / local GAAP). Demonstrated experience leading statutory reporting, audit management and regulatory compliance. Track record of operating in multi-currency and cross-border finance environments. Hands-on experience with financial systems and ERP platforms (Workday or equivalent). Practical experience with transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance. Background in financial services, professional services, or other regulated industries. Experience supporting international entities or regional finance operations across multiple jurisdictions.

title: TEC SEG TRABALHO( Contrato).
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Executar, sob supervisão, as atividades ligadas a segurança do trabalho, visando assegurar condições que eliminem ou reduzam exposição a riscos ocupacionais e ocorrência de incidentes do trabalho, observando o cumprimento de toda a legislação pertinente.

DESCRIÇÃO DAS PRINCIPAIS ATRIBUIÇÕES

– Realizar inspeções nos pontos de atuação da empresa, identificando os riscos existentes, tomando todas às providencias necessárias para mitigar ou eliminá-los, seguindo os padrões de Segurança do Trabalho preestabelecido pela empresa, a fim de manter os ambientes de trabalho o mais seguro possível;

– Ministrar treinamentos nos contratos, obedecendo padrões estipulados pela Empresa e cronograma anual, levando em consideração os atendimentos legais e a demanda local, com o objetivo de conscientizar os funcionários nos assuntos relacionados à segurança no trabalho e do trabalhador, bem como a instrução do profissional no manuseio e uso de máquinas, equipamentos e utensílios;

– Elaborar e ministrar o cronograma anual de Diálogo Diário de Segurança (DDS), registando lista de presença e formalizar relatório de execução;

– Prestar orientações da utilização dos EPIs e EPCs, bem como fiscalizar o uso adequado e acondicionamento, visando a aplicabilidade das legislações vigentes e os padrões da empresa. Também é responsabilidade do Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho fiscalizar que todos os profissionais sob sua responsabilidade tenham as fichas de EPIs preenchidas corretamente, fazendo a verificação da validade do CA e disponibilizá-las no posto de trabalho.

– Realizar todas as atividades pertinentes à regulamentação da comissão interna de prevenção de acidentes (CIPA), referentes às reuniões, eleição, atas e registro de documentação;

– Auxiliar nas tratativas de Incidentes do Trabalho e realizar investigação das causas, utilizando formulários e padrões estabelecidos pela empresa, com o objetivo de fornecer ao SESMT as informações necessárias para levantamento das estatísticas de incidentes do trabalho;

– Quando cabível, contribuir com os planos para atendimento a emergências dos pontos de serviços da empresa, seguindo padrões preconizados pelo SESMT local, com o objetivo da preservação de vidas em caso de sinistros;

– Confeccionar e monitorar o andamento e atualização do Programa de Gerenciamento de Riscos (PGR) e Análise Ergonómica do Trabalho (AET) em atendimento a NR-9 e NR17 respectivamente;

– Realizar nas etapas de realização de Semana Interna de Prevenção de Acidente no Trabalho (SIPAT), nos contratos, organizando as atividades e recursos necessários, contribuindo com a CIPA da Empresa instalada na unidade em questão;

– Acompanhar fiscalizações e auditorias, atendendo aos órgãos fiscalizadores e auditores, informando se necessários os padrões de Segurança do Trabalho preestabelecidos pela empresa; a fim de evitar autuações, notificações, bem como outros tipos de advertências;

– Realizar todos os Check-lists programados;

– Trabalhar sob supervisão periódica, se necessário, sendo orientado em qualquer fase das atividades desenvolvidas, utilizando conhecimentos suficientes para execução das tarefas contidas no cargo;

– Realizar inspeções de segurança e organização, visando adequações de máquinas, equipamento e utensílios a fim de atender as determinações da Norma Regulamentadora, elaborando relatórios das não conformidades e propondo plano

de ação para correção;

– Fazer análises riscos, através de APR Análise Preliminar de Risco e emitir PT Permissão de Trabalho, tais como Trabalhos em Altura, espaço confinado, limpezas em calhas, atividades estas que deverão ser acompanhadas por ele e equipe de manutenção do posto de trabalho;

– Analisar, inspecionar e ministrar orientações de acordo com PGR do posto de trabalho, junto a equipe operacional, levantando possíveis falhas e oportunidades de melhoria;

– Garantir que as FISQPs relativos aos produtos químicos utilizados estejam validadas e disponíveis no posto de trabalho, se atentando para as condições de uso e respeitando o cronograma de aferição e manutenção do diluidor;

– Auxiliar a equipe comercial em visitas técnicas de elaboração de projetos;

– Homologação de EPI e Produtos Químicos de acordo com o procedimento descrito;

– Elaborar Planilha de Perigos e Riscos;

– Manter a padronização documental em DMLs;

– Manter o mural nos contratos com informações atualizadas referentes a fluxos e indicadores pertinentes ao QSMS, bem como a pasta de documentos;

– Executar suas atividades afins, conforme suas competências, elaborando relatórios e indicadores mensais de suas atividades, conforme orientações de seu superior hierárquico.

MÍNIMO: Nível médio técnico completo (Técnico em segurança do trabalho).

DESEJÁVEL: Ensino Superior em curso, Administração, Engenharia ou área similar.

DESEJÁVEL: 01 ano.

The Director of Clinical Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for clinical services across multiple departments. This role ensures efficient workflows, compliance with regulatory standards, and alignment with organizational goals for quality, access, and financial sustainability. The Director will lead multidisciplinary teams, optimize patient throughput, and foster collaboration among clinical and administrative stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities Clinical Operations Oversight
  • Direct multi-disciplinary teams to ensure effective execution of clinical workflows, service delivery, and compliance with institutional and regulatory standards.
  • Implement and monitor KPIs such as patient wait times, double-booking volume, appointment utilization rates, and provider panel sizes to drive operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with department chairs to streamline workflows and improve access to care across high-volume specialties.
  • Oversee scheduling systems, capacity planning, and resource allocation to maximize productivity and patient satisfaction.
Stakeholder Engagement
  • Facilitate regular strategy sessions with senior leadership, department chairs, and finance teams to align clinical and financial priorities.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for external consultants, payers, and vendors involved in clinical operations and financial planning.
  • Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support strategic initiatives and operational goals.
Leadership & Team Development
  • Recruit, mentor, and develop clinical operations managers and support staff.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and patient-centered care.
  • Ensure staff compliance with policies, procedures, and performance standards.
Financial & Strategic Management
  • Partner with finance teams to develop and manage budgets for clinical operations.
  • Monitor revenue cycle performance and implement strategies to optimize reimbursement.
  • Support strategic planning initiatives, including expansion of service lines and adoption of innovative care models.
Quality & Compliance
  • Ensure adherence to accreditation standards, regulatory requirements, and institutional policies.
  • Collaborate with quality improvement teams to monitor patient safety indicators and implement corrective actions.
  • Lead operational readiness for audits and inspections.
Core Competencies
  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving
  • Leadership and team development
  • Financial acumen and budget management
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Management, or related field; Master’s preferred.
  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in clinical operations or practice management, including 3–5 years in a leadership role.
  • Demonstrated expertise in healthcare workflows, scheduling optimization, and performance improvement.
  • Strong knowledge of regulatory compliance, reimbursement policies, and healthcare IT systems.
Working Conditions & Physical Requirements
  • Standard office environment with occasional travel to clinical sites.
  • Ability to work extended hours during peak operational periods.

Compensation Range: $140,000 - $150,000
